PopupText: Ah the sweet smell of the locker room! Here's where we can pick our team colors.
Get us more kits by completing achievements! You can also buy them from the SHOP or during certain tournaments.
Also, some of us can produce cool POWERS when the right NUMBERS are rolled.
That was a good game! But I think it's time we got some fresh legs on our team...
In fact, Jerry Hattrick was with us on loan from the neighboring team!
Let's go into MANAGE mode and make some changes!
Good to see you here, Coach! Our Trophy Cabinet is sparse for now! But with your help we'll fill it up real fast!
Complete these ACHIEVEMENTS to attract new players and sponsors to our team!
Excellent! I have a feeling he's going to take us on a winning streak!
Also, add your extra players to the BENCH once you start hiring more of them. Now, let's go PLAY our match against the local college!
It might feel a little random for now, but you'll soon get to choose the kinds of dice we use.
Hi there! The new Dice Soccer fad has just begun, and we are really eager to play!
I've managed to get a few friends to make a team. Now all we need is a coach -- YOU!
Let's head to the practice grounds and get started! Tap on the TRAINING SEASON to begin!
If you're tired, you can TAP near the edges of the screen instead of shaking it.
Welcome to the MANAGE screen!
This is where you can change our starting lineup, before any game!
Tap on Jerry Hattrick (the old guy in the top left corner) in order to replace him.
That was quite the match eh? Now onto our last training game for the season.
We're currently in LEAGUE mode, which means we just have to complete one match to unlock the next!
In future LEAGUEs, we'll have to earn a number of stars before progressing to the next season.
Play TIME is limited - until the clock below counts down to zero! Each ROLL uses up about a minute of time.
Looking for new options in your FORWARD lineup? This is the right place!
Remember, the numbers on their cards are the numbers that they can roll during the game.
Now you're getting the hang of it. Play more matches until we get PROMOTED to the next season.
Experiment with different player combinations to improve your dice rolls!
Hurray! For making it this far, we've been invited to our first tournament of the season! Tap the T1 tab to access the available matches!
You Scored!!! Get more goals to ensure your victory!
You've selected a DEFENDER position!
All slots in defense are currently full. But you can always shuffle them around.
You'll have to complete a number of matches each season, in order to progress.
Let's try this first training game against THE NEIGHBOURS! Tap PLAY to begin!
You've selected a GOALKEEPER position!
You've already got ME in goal - but there might be better goalies here soon!
Alright! That's the end of training! We've been invited to join the Bootcamp Season!
The matches will be longer and tougher, so it's time to man up!
Go back to the previous screen and scroll on to SEASON ONE!
Your shot was saved! Let's try again soon!
In TOURNAMENT mode, WIN each match to unlock the next. Each match has no reward, but HUGE CASH will be won in the FINALS!
Dice Soccer rules allow us to make as many SUBSTITUTIONS as we like during a game!
But we can only choose from 4 reserves at a time. TAP on the player whom you want to remove from the lineup.
Every time your forward line rolls a 3, one of your players will trigger the critical 2x ability. Use this power to boost your dice!
Ah Coach! You made it! Our team is here and warming up already.
There's so much more talent out here amongst the competition. We should try recruiting them as we go along!
Also, remember to add players to your BENCH before a match starts. Only these players can be accessed from the pause menu later.
They've scored! Let's try and fight back!
Season 3!! These are Professional teams we're taking on now, but fear not, I'm sure you've learnt plenty of tricks getting us here!
Remember: The total of our dice and powers has to BEAT theirs! If the numbers are tied, nothing moves, and we all have to roll again.
Welcome to Multiplayer mode! Challenge your friends via GameCenter of Bluetooth.
Get points as we win, level up and show off our cool trophies.
You can also manage your team from here. There's lots of big money to be won!
Tap the PLAY ON button to skip any re-rolls you have remaining. Use this feature ONLY when the outcome is inevitable!
We lost! That's ok, it's still a long way to go.
You can always replay any games you've lost and try to improve your score!
Careful coach, this team's Captain's ability makes them to WIN every encounter that should be a TIE. Time to fight extra hard!
Whoa! Looks like there's been some kind of mixup. This isn't the kind of football team we were expecting!
They look far too big and strong. That's fine though, we've got a wild card of our own!
We could use all the help we can get coach. Hire up some new Entourage members via the Manage screen!
Good job. Let's try for a win next time!
Winning games will attract more players to offer us their services!
HIRE these new talents to strengthen our lineup.
This is where we get a PREVIEW of our opponents. We won't always know their entire lineup, but even the slightest info can be helpful.
Once you're done admiring the enemy team, tap on MANAGE to inspect our own squad.
Great! Now you can choose from any of the available forwards or midfielders to take up his spot.
I suggest putting in our newly acquired midfielder. Find him under the green MID tab at the bottom of the screen!
The bench can hold up to 4 reserve players. These reserves can be swapped into their positions during a match.
Good job! Now TAP on the Streaker, HIRE him, and SELECT him into our team!
Regular hiring of players is the best way to succeed as the matches get tougher. Tap on any player cards for more on their abilities.
This is a tough season, Coach. But we'll get THROUGH it! Just gotta find a way to beat these teams quick!
And it's ok if we lose a couple of matches on the way. We can always come back to win them later!
Some players have the THROUGH PASS ability. When this triggers, they'll immediately progress forward. Watch Out!
Would you look at that! There's a whole bandwagon of folks here to lend us their support!
I think we should bring a couple of them to our matches for some extra benefits!
The Entourage! Hurray! Selecting these fans, officials and specators to come to our matches will be real fun!
It looks like we can use 2 of them per match for some extra bonuses!
TAP on the card to read more about his abilties. Then HIRE and SELECT him.
This is the DECK, where you can review your players and UNLOCK, HIRE or SELL them!
TAP on a card to enlarge it, and TAP on the card once again to read about its abilities!
The game is about to begin... OH WAIT - we haven't told you how we play yet!
It's quite simple actually, just Shake OR Tap your screen and we'll all transform into our DICE form!
We're playing from the left side - if our DICE numbers ADD up higher than theirs, then we get control of the ball and can move forward!
Welcome to the SHOP! Use external funding here to get us more CASH and some shiny new threads too.
Congrats! What a good start!
Scoring more goals will get us more stars!
Use the money we've earned to HIRE more players for our team!
